# Testing Requirements Checklist: GRPO Prompt Batch Size Refactoring

**Purpose**: Validate the quality and completeness of testing-related requirements for the prompt batching refactor.
**Created**: 2025-10-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by `/speckit.checklist` to assess requirement quality before test implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all steps for prompt broadcasting, trajectory aggregation, and optimizer stepping documented so testers know the full batching workflow? [Completeness, Spec §Functional Requirements]
- [x] CHK002 Are telemetry expectations (fill ratio, smoothed reward, lagging ranks) explicitly captured for verification? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 2]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK003 Is “steady upward trend” defined with the reward_average_window or comparison baseline needed for objective assessment? [Clarity, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [x] CHK004 Are abort conditions for insufficient trajectories described in specific, testable language? [Clarity, Spec §Functional Requirements]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK005 Do plan.md and tasks.md describe the same metric names (`rl/prompt_batch/*`) as the spec so telemetry checks remain aligned? [Consistency, Plan §Technical Context; Tasks §Phase 4]
- [x] CHK006 Are the assumptions about sequential generation and single optimizer step consistent across spec, plan, and tasks? [Consistency, Spec §Functional Requirements; Plan §Summary; Tasks §US1]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK007 Can the smoke-test acceptance criteria (32 trajectories → 1 optimizer step) be uniquely measured without additional interpretation? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Story 1; Tasks §US1 Tests]
- [x] CHK008 Are telemetry acceptance checks tied to concrete timing or freshness requirements (e.g., “within 60 seconds per cycle”) to avoid subjective review? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Story 2]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK009 Do requirements cover both CPU-only synthetic runs and GPU-backed realism checks, clarifying when each is required or optional? [Coverage, Tasks §Polish; Quickstart §Expected Metrics]
- [x] CHK010 Are scenarios for lagging ranks and partial trajectory shortfalls specified so tests can simulate them? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases; Tasks §US2 Tests]

- [x] CHK013 Do requirements state acceptable runtime bounds or resource usage expectations for smoke tests to prevent unbounded runs? [Non-Functional, Spec §Testing Guidance]
